title: Assessing Per-Sample Membership Inference Vulnerability without Retraining
abstract: arXiv:2602.15919v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent work in the privacy literature shows that sample-targeted membership inference attacks (MIAs) significantly outperform untargeted approaches by a wide margin. Motivated by this observation, we address the following question: can the privacy vulnerability of individual training points be assessed without training shadow models? We show that per-sample exposure to MIA is governed not only by a point's loss, but also by a data-dependent geometric measure. In the linear setting, we derive a closed-form decomposition of individual black-box MIA vulnerability into a population leverage score and a residual loss term, making explicit how sample-dependent geometry translates into privacy exposure. Since the final layer of most modern architectures is linear, we extend this framework to deep networks and propose a surrogate score operating on last-layer representations that requires only a single trained model and no shadow model

translated_title: 无需重新训练的逐样本成员推断脆弱性评估
translated_abstract: 隐私领域的最新研究表明，针对特定样本的成员推断攻击（MIA）大幅超越了非定向方法。受此观察启发，我们研究以下问题：能否在不训练影子模型的情况下评估单个训练点的隐私脆弱性？我们证明，每个样本面临的MIA风险不仅取决于其损失值，还取决于一个依赖于数据的几何度量。在线性设定下，我们推导出了个体黑盒MIA脆弱性的闭式分解，将其分解为总体杠杆分数和残差损失项，从而明确揭示了样本相关的几何特性如何转化为隐私暴露。由于大多数现代架构的最后一层是线性的，我们将该框架扩展到深度网络，提出了一种基于最后一层表示的替代评分方法，该方法仅需一个训练好的模型，无需影子模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需影子模型的逐样本成员推断脆弱性评估方法，将个体隐私风险闭式分解为总体杠杆分数和残差损失项，并利用深度网络最后一层的线性表示计算替代评分，仅需单个训练好的模型即可完成评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a shadow-model-free framework for assessing per-sample membership inference vulnerability by deriving a closed-form decomposition of individual privacy risk into a population leverage score and a residual loss term, and computing a surrogate score from last-layer representations that requires only a single trained model.
